hero.headline: The DMV's biggest nights out for young adults.
hero.lede: Other groups send out a bar address and hope for the best. We build the whole night around meeting people. Dance lessons to begin the night, a live band, a few hundred young adults in a room worth dressing for, and hosts whose job is introducing you. Come on your own, bring friends, or make it a date night. Plenty of people here have met the person they married.

story.heading: Started for people who moved here and didn't know anyone yet.
story.lede: DC Social Collective launched in 2021, when the pandemic had emptied out the young adult scene. Five years on it is one of the largest young adult communities in the DMV, with about 6,000 people a year coming out, and its nights sell out.
story.body: Most of the room is in their twenties and early thirties. You don't need a date and you don't need to be Catholic, though that is where our roots are. You come, you take the lesson, and you leave knowing people.
